findings.title: One-sided termination for convenience
findings.impact: AtliQ cannot terminate the agreement for convenience if the project becomes unviable or circumstances change.

citations.quote: Aldergrove may terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice, paying for work done

findings.standard: On any termination for convenience AtliQ is paid for all work done, including work in progress. Notice is mutual. Client contracts: reasonable notice (typically 30+ days). Freelancer / vendor agreements: a mutual short exit (about 15 days, as with Rohan Iyer) is AtliQ's standard and fair to both sides.
findings.counterPosition: Make termination for convenience mutual, allowing either party to terminate on 30 days' written notice with AtliQ paid for work done and work in progress.

UK GDPR processing role and UK tenant storage requirements are defined.
